aiInstructions:
The 'AdventureWorksLH' data source is the AdventureWorks data warehouse, modelled as a star schema. It contains sales transactions (fact table) and descriptive dimension tables. Use it for questions about internet sales, customers, products, promotions, resellers, sales territories and time-based trends.

## Tables and purpose
- factinternetsales: one row per order line for online (internet) sales. This is the only fact table in scope and the source of all sales measures.
- dimcustomer: customer demographics and contact details (name, birth date, gender, income, education, occupation, etc.).
- dimgeography: city, state/province, country region code and country name. Linked to customers and resellers.
- dimsalesterritory: sales regions (region, country, group).
- dimproduct: product details (name, colour, size, list price, standard cost).
- dimproductcategory: product category names.
- dimpromotion: promotions and discounts (name, type, category, discount percentage, start and end dates).
- dimreseller: reseller (business) details. Resellers do not appear in factinternetsales; see the limitations below.
- dimdate: calendar and fiscal attributes (day, month, quarter, year, fiscal period, weekday).

## Relationships (join keys)
- factinternetsales.CustomerKey = dimcustomer.CustomerKey
- factinternetsales.ProductKey = dimproduct.ProductKey
- factinternetsales.PromotionKey = dimpromotion.PromotionKey
- factinternetsales.SalesTerritoryKey = dimsalesterritory.SalesTerritoryKey
- factinternetsales.OrderDateKey = dimdate.DateKey (also DueDateKey and ShipDateKey for due and ship dates)
- dimcustomer.GeographyKey = dimgeography.GeographyKey
- dimreseller.GeographyKey = dimgeography.GeographyKey
- dimgeography.SalesTerritoryKey = dimsalesterritory.SalesTerritoryKey

## Measures and business rules
- Sales revenue = SUM(SalesAmount). Order quantity = SUM(OrderQuantity).
- Number of orders = COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber). Do not count rows, because one order has multiple lines.
- Gross profit = SUM(SalesAmount) - SUM(TotalProductCost).
- Discounts = SUM(DiscountAmount). Freight = SUM(Freight). Tax = SUM(TaxAmt).
- Unless the user says otherwise, "date" means order date (OrderDateKey). Use ship date only when the user asks about shipping or delivery.
- Customer counts use COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerKey).
- Promotion "No Discount" represents orders without a promotion. Exclude it when analysing promotion effectiveness.

## Query guidance
- Always join the fact table to dimensions through the surrogate keys above, never by name.
- Use dimdate for year, quarter and month grouping, and for fiscal period questions.
- For trends, group by calendar year and month and order chronologically.
- For customer location, go through dimcustomer, then dimgeography. For sales region, join directly through SalesTerritoryKey on the fact table.
- Return the top 10 rows for ranking questions unless the user specifies another number.
- State the currency basis and time period used when presenting totals.

## Limitations
- Only internet sales are available. Reseller sales, finance, call centre, inventory and quota data are not included, so questions about reseller revenue cannot be answered. If asked, say so instead of guessing.
- Product subcategory data is not included, so analysis is at product and product category level only.
- If a question needs a table or column not listed here, say what is missing instead of inventing it.
